quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: When driving at night, you should:

options.text: Always use your high beams.
Look directly at the headlights of an oncoming vehicle.
Stay farther away from the car in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: Night driving is harder because you cannot see as well. It is difficult to judge how fast other cars are going or how far away they are. Stay farther back from the car ahead of you. This gives you more time to stop if they brake suddenly. Use your headlights, and follow the rules for when to use high beams and low beams.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks entering.
Truck exit only.
A steep hill is coming down ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is coming down ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead. Check your brakes before you go down.

questions.question: Large vehicles have blind spots that can extend up to 200 feet directly behind the vehicle.

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.explanation: Large vehicles have blind spots that can extend up to 200 feet behind them. Do not follow closely behind a large vehicle. The driver cannot see you there.

questions.question: When you drive through an area where children are playing, you should expect them:

options.text: To know when it is safe to cross the street.
To stop at the curb before crossing the street.
To run into the street in front of you without looking.
Not to cross the street unless they are with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: To run into the street in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be careful when children are nearby. They may not understand the danger. They can run into the street in front of you without looking.

questions.question: When in a travel lane on the roadway:

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may make a U-turn or back up if you missed the freeway entrance ramp.
Do not stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep moving until you reach a safe place to pull off the road. If you miss your exit or turn, do not back up. Go to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines down the center of a road mean that passing is:

options.text: Allowed from both directions.
Allowed only from your direction.
Not allowed from either direction.

questions.explanation: A double yellow line means no car from either direction is allowed to cross it to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Change lanes suddenly without warning.
Check for other vehicles moving into the same lane.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for vehicles in your blind spot. Always use your turn signal before moving to give other drivers time to react. Make sure no other vehicle is moving into the same lane.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:

options.text: Slow down.
Drive carefully without stopping.
Merge to the right.
Stop before entering the intersection.

questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear. Go only when it is safe. At a railroad crossing with a flashing red light, a train is near. Yield to the train. Go only when the lights stop flashing and all warning devices turn off.

questions.question: When entering an interstate highway, you should:

options.text: Stop, check for cars, and enter when safe.
Slow down to 25 mph before entering the traffic lane.
Check for cars, speed up to match traffic, and merge when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for cars, speed up to match traffic, and merge when safe.
questions.explanation: Do not stop when entering a highway. Use the acceleration lane to speed up and match the speed of traffic already on the highway. Then merge smoothly when it is safe.

questions.question: The posted speed limit is the fastest you can legally drive in that area.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest legal speed under good conditions. You must slow down if conditions are bad, such as when roads are slippery or when you cannot see clearly.

questions.question: At an intersection with a flashing yellow light, you must:

options.text: Wait for the green light before going.
Slow down and cross carefully.
Stop before crossing.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Watch for other cars and pedestrians before crossing.

questions.question: Which statement about drugs and driving is true?

options.text: Prescription drugs are safe if you don't feel drowsy.
Over-the-counter drugs can affect your driving.
Only illegal drugs affect driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Over-the-counter drugs can affect your driving.
questions.explanation: Prescription and over-the-counter drugs can impair driving. This includes drugs for colds, allergies, and anxiety. It is illegal to drive while impaired by any drug, whether illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using emergency signals. You should:

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as possible.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is not using its siren or lights, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment depends on:

options.text: Whether you drink beer instead of wine.
Whether you drink wine instead of beer.
Whether you drink hard cider or mixed drinks.
How much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: How much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: All types of alcohol impair your reflexes and judgment the same way. Only the amount of alcohol in your blood matters, not the type of drink.

questions.question: Emergency vehicles:

options.text: Have the right-of-way when using sirens and flashing lights.
Can give instructions over a loudspeaker.
Can follow each other.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You must yield to police cars, fire engines, and ambulances using a siren and flashing lights. Follow any instructions from their loudspeakers. Emergency vehicles often follow each other, so only proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: This sign warns that:

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
Trucks are not allowed on the hill.
A logging road is ahead.
Trucks are on the hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: You exit a freeway on a downhill ramp that curves. You should:

options.text: Slow down to a safe speed before the curve.
Slow to the freeway speed limit.
Begin braking after you enter the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to a safe speed before the curve.
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. You cannot see hazards ahead, and braking in a curve can cause skidding.

questions.question: Drivers may not pass:

options.text: On a hill.
In a no passing zone.
In the middle of a curve.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill, in a curve, or in a no passing zone. Only pass when it is safe.

questions.question: You may use your horn when you:

options.text: Have to stop suddenly.
Are passing another car.
Lose control of your car.
Are passing a bicyclist.

questions.explanation: Use your horn if you lose control of your vehicle. This alerts other drivers to the danger.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must stop like at a stop sign.
Cannot go until it turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop like at a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.
